text: {"question":"Which observational comparison presented in the paper demonstrates that the dark QCD model can reduce the discrepancy between early‑ and late‑time measurements of the Hubble constant?","reference_answer":"The comparison of the ratios of transverse, dilation, and Hubble distances to the sound horizon (Fig. 5) using DESI DR2 data shows that the dark QCD model’s predictions shift these ratios toward the values preferred by late‑time probes, thereby alleviating the H₀ tension."}
